Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Company Overview 
 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace.
 The Impact You Will Create 
Drive the increase of our collective QA capabilities, effectiveness, and overall software quality across product teams.
Analyze requirements, user stories, and testability to design, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test data.
Monitor test execution, conduct peer reviews, and perform end-to-end testing, logging failure reports and resolving quality issues with management.
Act as a Subject Matter Expert for QA processes and methodologies, providing coaching, training in mandatory best practices (MBP), and independent health checks.
Perform quality audits, ensure compliance with QA standards, and evaluate QA metrics to optimize test management processes.
 Experience And Skills You Will Need 
 Education & Experience: University degree in Information Technology (or equivalent education) with 3+ years of hands-on QA experience .
 Testing Expertise: Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, concepts, and full SDLC lifecycle, including troubleshooting , bug isolation , cross-device/cross-platform , and end-to-end testing .
 Tools & Processes: Practical experience with test case management and bug tracking tools, writing detailed failure reports, and applying ISTQB testing terminology.
 Tools & Processes: Practical experience with test case management and bug tracking tools, writing detailed failure reports, and applying ISTQB testing terminology.
 Agile & Communication: Proven ability to thrive in agile teams, paired with strong analytical, coordination, and presentation skills.
 Languages: Fluency in English (spoken and written).
 Nice to have 
 SAP Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with SAP EWM -specific processes.
 Automation Exposure: Basic experience with test automation tools (e.g., Tosca, Selenium, SeeTest, Ranorex, Jenkins, IntelliJ, or Xray for Jira).
 Certification & Languages: ISTQB certification and German language skills are a plus.
 Our Offer 
25 days annual leave + 1 day annual leave after 5 years in the company
Meal tickets
Additional health insurance
A good work life balance with flexible working time
A pleasant and diverse environment with regular events, team buildings and stimulating activities
A huge array of tools & technologies available on the spot and ready for a steady personal development
Variety of opportunities with one of the strongest and largest retail companies in the world
You will be part of an international team composed of people from different countries and backgrounds
Onboarding and support/mentoring
